reasoning_chain.name: Casualty or near-miss occurs; master assesses situation
Master maintains proper look-out (Rule 5); determines risk of collision (Rules 7-8)
Master takes action to avoid collision (Rules 13-19); sounds signals (Rules 32-37)
If persons in distress: master proceeds with all speed to assist (SOLAS V/33.1)
SAR services coordinate (SAR Convention Chapters 1-5); master cooperates
